shouldFix.whyItLands: The remeasurement clause is the operative adoption-time stability condition: it says which files must be unmoved for append-only COORD growth to be PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT. Turn 1's 'six' in this same clause was a SHOULD-FIX from both reviewers because the clause must identify the fixed set exactly. An undefined member with no pinned digest is a larger gap than a miscount: a reader cannot determine from the entry what 'file 02 unmoved' means or check it. The turn-1 clause did not name file 02; the turn-2 rewrite added it. This is a repair that introduced a new defect in the operative clause. It does not touch the classification and is a one-line fix.

advisories.note: Clause 3 fixes gate 2's domain by gate 2's own words ('every remaining acceptance-evidence member') and by D-294 Decision 3. The same pinned D-056 subject defines the set expressly: Decision 1 bullet 3 reads the SATISFIED legend for eligible rows 'as: the independently reviewed design contract or the already-recorded D-000 decision, plus the named C4/DR-G* remainder list', and the legend it reads is 'exact acceptance evidence is linked and independently reviewed'. A citation-refresh successor is in neither half of that set. Citing bullet 3 would close the domain in adopted text rather than by inference from gate 2's category list. Honesty work; the classification stands without it.

Two phrases in clause 3 are looser than the bytes. 'D-294 Decision 3 defines what the owed successor does': Decision 3 states the refresh duty of a successor 'issued for any reason'; it is the whole content only of a successor owed on (b) alone, which is the class this entry names, and the sentence would be exact if it said so. 'Changes no binding content of the accepted contract': preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 has binds = "NOTHING", so 'binding content' is vacuous; the precise claim, available from v10's own purpose and joinCurrencyAudit.standing, is that the fourteen classes' invariant/input/pass content, the seven dispositions and p1p2g3Mapping are unchanged and only the cross-lineage currency and partition sentences move.

The D-315 item 4 (G3-HOSTILE) comparison is quoted accurately ('may proceed under D-293's existing delegation if it adds no semantic choice'), but it is a delegation ruling about who may author a mechanical remasurement, not an eligibility classification under D-056. As a 'Compare' it shows the register already recognises the no-semantic-choice category and nothing more. The clause's reasoning is complete without it, and it should not be read as a second ground.

The fixed measurement set is 'the eight leftover-join files ... the cited and current version of each of the four lineages', which by its own definition excludes g29-leftover-join.v6 and g30-leftover-join.v8, the two files the g29/g30 Ground column relies on for the first recorded existingGate change. They are covered by the preceding sentence ('If a cited file moves ... re-measure'), and the (b) test itself runs cited → current, so the count is not false. Saying that the intermediates are historical inputs outside the fixed set would pre-empt the obvious 'eight or ten' attack.

clause3Classification.gate2ReachesCitationRefresh: Not sustained. Pinned gate 2: 'Every remaining acceptance-evidence member is only harness execution, fixture execution, or qualification measurement. Authoring of fixtures, schemas, successors, actor-joins, missing design, or still-UNDECIDED numbers is not a remainder this amendment may split.' Both sentences are about the row's remainder; 'remainder' is what the SATISFIED legend, read per Decision 1 bullet 3, leaves after the design contract: 'the named C4/DR-G* remainder list'. The legend itself is 'exact acceptance evidence is linked and independently reviewed'. A D-294 Decision 2(b) successor is not linked from the row, is not the design contract (gate 1 is fixed at v10's digest by D-316), and is not on the named remainder list. It is a maintenance duty on the citing artifact under D-294 Decision 2. No sentence of the pinned subject makes the currency of a design contract's cross-lineage citations an acceptance-evidence member, and D-294 Decision 1 makes those citations custody at recording rather than standing claims, so v10 remains a complete member.
clause3Classification.decision3Characterisation: Not refuted. D-294 Decision 3: a successor 'refreshes its cross-lineage citations to the versions current at its dispatch and labels the superseded ones as not current ... No frozen artifact is edited to achieve this.' v10's own purpose and joinCurrencyAudit.standing describe the v8→v10 refresh as 42 sites (40 currency citations, 2 partition sentences) with the fourteen classes otherwise identical to v8's, the seven dispositions and p1p2g3Mapping byte-identical. The g29/g30 sentences a (b) refresh would move are of the form 'Current G29 leftover-join is g29 leftover-join.v4 (D-254). leftoverDesign remains [OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING].' inside existingGate / laterExecution; invariant, input and pass fields are untouched. The four v11-v14 Stage A rejections (16 blockers read by title) are predecessor-pin, disposition, partition-refresh-completeness and lineage-prose defects; one (PPBSV11-B2) rejected a candidate for reopening the Class A choice D-316 settled, which confirms that a refresh successor is not permitted to make eligibility or design choices. See ADV-2 for two loose phrases.
clause3Classification.d315Comparison: Accurately quoted; a delegation ruling, offered as 'Compare', not a ground — ADV-3.
clause3Classification.amendmentInReadingsClothes: Not sustained. Turn 1 asserted the gates were silent; turn 2 reads gate 2's quantifier and classifies an artifact class under it, in the same instrument D-294 used. The domain is defined in the pinned subject (ADV-1), the classification is consistent with it, and clause 8 states the consequence if the classification is rejected, so nothing is smuggled: if the reading fails, gates 4 and 5 wait or D-056 is amended in its own reviewed cycle.
clause3Classification.clause5Collapse: Not sustained. D-294 Decision 2(b) reliance is the citing artifact's own currency sentences depending on a sibling's projected values; acceptance evidence is the linked, independently reviewed set the legend and Decision 1 bullet 3 define. The first is a property of the artifact's sentences; the second is a property of the row. D-294 Decision 4 shows the two coexist: the eight citing joins 'remain current' while Decision 2 defines when they need a successor.

conclusion: OBJECT on one SHOULD-FIX only. The substantive turn-2 move holds: gate 2 quantifies over the row's acceptance-evidence remainder, which the pinned D-056 subject defines as the design contract plus the named C4/DR-G* remainder list; a D-294 Decision 2(b) citation-refresh successor is in neither, supplies no design, fixture, schema or number, and is a maintenance duty on the citing artifact rather than a member of the row's evidence. The distinction between reliance and acceptance evidence, the gate-3 consequence, and clause 8's stated fallback all follow; the four-pair measurement, the D-320/D-321 first-firing entries, the numbering claim, every digest and commit, and every turn-1 identifier landing reproduce from bytes. The one defect is in the operative remeasurement clause: the rewrite that fixed 'six' added 'file 02' to the fixed measurement set without defining it or pinning its digest (live 1811c682…, equal to v10's own pin). Drop the two words or add the row and definition; nothing else needs to move.
